stops.name: Mormon Rocks
stops.note: Tilted sandstone fins right off the I-15 Cajon climb.

stops.name: Wrightwood village
stops.note: Cocoa, pine-street shops, and a walk before the lifts.

stops.name: Jackson Lake
stops.note: Lake on Big Pines Highway, west of the village. Winter walk and picnic.

stops.name: Grassy Hollow Visitor Center
stops.note: Lookout and short walks on CA-2, just west of Mountain High.

stops.name: Devil's Punchbowl
stops.note: Sandstone amphitheater and short trails near Valyermo, a short hop off CA-138.

stops.name: Goodwill Southern California — Corona
stops.note: Quick stop off CA-91 at N Main St for extra fleece layers and wool socks on the drive out of OC.

stops.name: Savers — Rancho Cucamonga
stops.note: Large Foothill Blvd thrift store just off I-15 before the Cajon Pass climb — good rack of ski jackets and snow pants.

stops.name: High Desert Secondhand & Thrift
stops.note: Along Phelan Rd on the CA-138 approach to Wrightwood — mountain coats, gloves, and cabin books.

stops.name: Wrightwood Mountain Thrift & Vintage
stops.note: Village consignment and thrift off Park Dr — retro wool sweaters, beanies, and local mountain gear.

stops.name: Wrightwood Pizza Company
stops.note: Hand-tossed mountain pies and garlic knots on Evergreen Rd in Wrightwood village — classic stop after the lifts.

stops.name: Mile High Pizza & Deli — Wrightwood Village
stops.note: Hot slices, calzones, and subs right off Park Dr in the pines.

stops.name: Oggi's Sports Brewhouse & Pizza — Fontana / I-15
stops.note: Right off I-15 at Sierra Ave before the Cajon Pass climb.

stops.name: A&W All American Food — Ontario / I-15 Corridor
stops.note: Root beer floats in frosty mugs, Papa Burgers, and cheese curds on the drive north toward I-15.

stops.name: A&W All American Food — High Desert / I-15
stops.note: Quick drive-thru off the I-15 / CA-138 high-desert corridor for root beer floats and fries after the mountain.

stops.name: Claremont Village
stops.note: Walkable college-town blocks right before Mountain Ave starts the climb.

stops.name: Mt Baldy Village
stops.note: Canyon hamlet under the peaks on Mt Baldy Rd — last stop before Manker Flats.

stops.name: San Antonio Falls
stops.note: Short hike from Manker Flats to the waterfall under the ski hill.

stops.name: Icehouse Canyon
stops.note: Canyon trailhead below the village. Winter walk with traction.

stops.name: Baldy Lodge
stops.note: Food in the village on the way up Mt Baldy Road.

stops.name: Assistance League Thrift Shop — Brea / Fullerton
stops.note: Easy stop right off the CA-57 corridor heading north out of Orange County.

stops.name: ACTS Thrift Store — Foothill Blvd
stops.note: Big community thrift on Foothill Blvd right before turning north onto Mountain Ave / Mt Baldy Rd.

stops.name: The Grove Vintage & Thrift — Claremont Village
stops.note: Secondhand flannels, parkas, and vintage layers in Claremont Village at the foot of the canyon.

stops.name: Humane Society Thrift Shop — Upland / Foothill
stops.note: Just east of Mountain Ave along the base of the San Gabriels before the switchbacks.

stops.name: Pizza N' Such — Claremont Village
stops.note: Claremont Village staple on Yale Ave since 1977 — thick-crust pies and patio tables right below Mt. Baldy Rd.

stops.name: Mountain Ave Pizzeria — Upland / Foothill
stops.note: Right at Mountain Ave & Foothill Blvd — last pizza stop before heading up the canyon to Manker Flats.

stops.name: A&W All American Food — Mountain Ave
stops.note: Straight down Mountain Ave from the Mt. Baldy turnoff — classic A&W draft root beer, floats, and burgers.

stops.name: A&W All American Food — CA-57 Corridor
stops.note: Easy stop along the CA-57 route out of Orange County for root beer floats and chicken tenders.

stops.name: Rim of the World overlook
stops.note: CA-18 pull-off over the inland valleys on the climb.

stops.name: Big Bear Village / lake
stops.note: Stroll the village and the lake shore after the drive.

stops.name: Oak Glen (via CA-38)
stops.note: Apple-country detour if you take 38 instead of 330.

stops.name: Heaps Peak Arboretum
stops.note: Short paved trail on CA-18 between Running Springs and the lake.

stops.name: Lake Arrowhead Village
stops.note: Lakeside town detour on CA-18 before Big Bear.

stops.name: Castle Rock
stops.note: Short scramble above the lake, trailhead just east of the dam.

stops.name: Big Bear Alpine Zoo
stops.note: Moonridge rescue zoo, open in winter.

stops.name: Holcomb Valley
stops.note: Gold-rush valley north of the lake. Dirt roads — better when dry.

stops.name: Alpine Slide at Magic Mountain
stops.note: Snow play in the village in winter.

stops.name: Goodwill & Magnolia Ave Thrift — Riverside
stops.note: Right off CA-91 in Riverside on the way toward the I-215 / CA-330 junction.

stops.name: Assistance League Thrift Shop — Redlands / Highland
stops.note: At the foot of the San Bernardinos between the CA-330 and CA-38 climbs.

stops.name: Mountain Top Thrift — Running Springs
stops.note: Where CA-330 meets CA-18 just before Snow Valley — secondhand snow bibs, gloves, and mountain coats.

stops.name: DOVES Repeat Boutique Thrift — Big Bear
stops.note: Local charity thrift on Big Bear Blvd between Snow Summit and Bear Mountain — winter boots, jackets, and cabin finds.

stops.name: Bear Valley Community Thrift — Big Bear Blvd
stops.note: Secondhand ski clothes, fleece layers, and vintage lodge decor in town.

stops.name: Saucy Mama's Pizzeria — Big Bear Village
stops.note: Lively Pine Knot Ave pizzeria in Big Bear Village with loaded mountain pies and craft beer.

stops.name: Maggio's Pizza — Big Bear Blvd
stops.note: Family Big Bear pizza institution since 1978, right on Big Bear Blvd between Snow Summit and Bear Mountain.

stops.name: Rim of the World Pizza — Running Springs
stops.note: Right at the CA-330 / CA-18 junction in Running Springs, five minutes west of Snow Valley.

stops.name: A&W All American Food — Mentone / Redlands (CA-38)
stops.note: Iconic mountain-road A&W on Mentone Blvd at the foot of the CA-38 Big Bear climb — frosty mug root beer floats and Papa Burgers.

stops.name: A&W All American Food — San Bernardino / CA-330 Gate
stops.note: Along the I-215 / CA-330 approach before climbing up to Running Springs and Snow Valley.

stops.name: Alabama Hills / Mount Whitney view
stops.note: Boulder arches under Whitney, two minutes off 395 on Whitney Portal Road.

stops.name: Erick Schat's Bakkerÿ
stops.note: The classic 395 stop for sheepherder bread and sandwiches.

stops.name: Convict Lake
stops.note: Short spur off 395 just south of the Mammoth turnoff — big peaks over the water.

stops.name: June Lake village
stops.note: Quiet loop town on CA-158 at the foot of June Mountain.

stops.name: Manzanar
stops.note: Year-round historic site at Independence, on the drive north.

stops.name: Laws Railroad Museum
stops.note: Railroad museum a few minutes off 395.

stops.name: Earthquake Fault
stops.note: Short walk in town at Mammoth. Usually open in winter.

stops.name: Minaret Vista
stops.note: Ritter and Banner view above the Mammoth turnoff. The last stretch of road often closes in winter.

stops.name: Gull Lake
stops.note: First lake on the June Lake Loop, a minute from the village.

stops.name: Mono Lake South Tufa
stops.note: Tufa towers east of Lee Vining — year-round, just north of June.

stops.name: Devils Postpile
stops.note: Basalt columns and Rainbow Falls. Summer shuttle only.

stops.name: Southern Inyo Hospital Auxiliary Thrift Shop
stops.note: Right on Main St (US-395) in Lone Pine — wool flannels, Western hats, and trail layers under Mt. Whitney.

stops.name: Hidden Treasures & New To You Thrift — Main St
stops.note: Along US-395 in downtown Bishop near Schat's — down parkas, fleece pullovers, and secondhand Eastern Sierra gear.

stops.name: The Cast Off Thrift Store
stops.note: Mammoth Hospital Auxiliary thrift on Old Mammoth Rd — famous local stop for lightly used ski jackets, goggles, and snow pants.

stops.name: Second Chance Thrift — Mammoth Lakes
stops.note: Local charity thrift off Main St (CA-203) supporting Disabled Sports Eastern Sierra — winter shells, gloves, and mountain layers.

stops.name: Giovanni's Pizzeria — Mammoth Lakes
stops.note: Mammoth's go-to apres-ski pizza and pitchers spot on Old Mammoth Rd since 1984.

stops.name: John's Pizza Works — Mammoth Lakes
stops.note: Hot pies, wings, and arcade games right on Main St (CA-203) coming into Mammoth.

stops.name: Upper Crust Pizza Co. — Bishop (US-395)
stops.note: Handcrafted pizza on N Main St (US-395) in Bishop before the Sherwin Grade climb to Mammoth and June.

stops.name: Pizza Factory — Lone Pine (US-395)
stops.note: Classic Owens Valley pizza stop right on Main St (US-395) under Mt. Whitney.

stops.name: A&W All American Food — Bishop (US-395)
stops.note: Legendary US-395 Eastern Sierra stop at 1255 N Main St in Bishop — frosty root beer floats, Papa Burgers, and cheese curds on the Mammoth & June run.

stops.name: A&W All American Food — High Desert / US-395 Approach
stops.note: Desert highway stop where I-15 meets the US-395 north corridor toward Kramer Junction and Owens Valley.
